items.title: Remove vendored Anthropic document skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx)
items.description:
Remove vendored Anthropic document skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx)

These four skills were vendored from anthropics/skills under Anthropic's
proprietary license. Remove them with their tests, illustrated guides,
diagrams, and skill-requirements entries.

- Drop the office/ test contract that only those skills used; move the
  schematic-generator drift check it also held into schematic.py.
- scientific-slides no longer calls skills/pptx/ scripts: PowerPoint decks
  are built with PptxGenJS or python-pptx and reviewed through LibreOffice
  plus the bundled pdf_to_images.py and validate_presentation.py.
- liteparse and markitdown point PDF manipulation at pypdf.
- Update skill counts to 177 across README and docs, remove the skills from
  the catalog, guide index, and workflow examples, and prune them from the
  security report.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

items.title: fix(skills): make console diagnostics safe for cp1252
items.description:
fix(skills): make console diagnostics safe for cp1252

Fixes #292. Use readable ASCII status markers in 42 Python scripts across 20 skills, preserve figure and prompt text, keep copied validators/generators identical, and add static plus real-console regression coverage.

Validation: all 20 affected isolated skill suites and spec checks pass. PyMC required a process-local PYTENSOR_FLAGS=cxx=,linker=py,blas__ldflags= override because the native macOS linker could not find d64.
